name: thorlabs_lpvise100a
reference: approx digitized/estimated from Thorlabs LPVISE100-A datasheet description (400-700nm dichroic sheet polarizer laminated between N-BK7 windows, polarization efficiency >99%, ~38% average transmission for unpolarized light => T_parallel peak ~0.80, ER~8000:1 typical mid-band per product page); exact vendor curve graph is JS-rendered and not machine-fetchable, so the wavelength dependence here is an engineering approximation anchored to the stated avg-transmission/ER figures, not a pixel digitization -- www.thorlabs.com/thorproduct.cfm?partnumber=LPVISE100-A

name: edmund_wiregrid_vis
reference: modeled on Edmund Optics 25mm Dia. Wire Grid Polarizing Film, stock #55880 (400-1200nm operating range; vendor-listed typical spec Single Tavg=44%, Parallel Tavg=36%, Crossed Tavg=0.02%, i.e. ER_avg~1800:1); Edmund's product page returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the wavelength-dependent shape (ER rising with wavelength, typical of wire-grid polarizers as period/lambda decreases) is an engineering approximation anchored to the vendor's stated average numbers, not a pixel digitization -- www.edmundoptics.com/p/25mm-dia-wire-grid-polarizing-film/55880/

name: thorlabs_cp1l532
reference: modeled on Thorlabs CP1L532 left-handed circular polarizer (532nm design: dichroic linear-polarizing film + liquid-crystal-polymer zero-order quarter-wave film laminated between N-BK7 windows, broadband -A AR coating 350-700nm); underlying diattenuation curve is an engineering approximation (ER peaking near the 532nm design wavelength, degrading toward the 350/700nm AR-band edges) since the datasheet's interactive curve is not machine-fetchable -- www.thorlabs.com/thorproduct.cfm?partnumber=CP1L532

name: thorlabs_cp1r532
reference: modeled on Thorlabs CP1R532 (right-handed counterpart of CP1L532: same construction, same -A AR coating band 350-700nm, opposite QWP fast-axis orientation); shares the CP1L532 diattenuation table since only handedness differs, which is carried by the 'type' column, not by T_parallel/T_perpendicular -- www.thorlabs.com/thorproduct.cfm?partnumber=CP1R532
